newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares, futures rise with foreign trend.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares, futures rise with foreign trend.

text.p: 1620 GMT - Portuguese shares and futures rose in sympathy with foreign markets in heavy turnover of 23 billion escudos. The market began the session calmly, but picked up later with other European bourses and Wall Street. A stronger dollar underlined the positive mood. The most active shares included utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, Portugal Telecom, and banking stocks, such as Banco Comercial Portugues, Banco Espirito Santo, BPSM and Banco Totta e Acores.

* Dealers said remarks of Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco at a conference in Frankfurt boosted optimism. He told Reuters Financial Television that he was not worried by the 40 percent rise in Lisbon shares so far this year.
* Dealers said the market had turned its attention to the FOMC meeting, but most players expected no changes in U.S. monetary policy.
